hard_stops: never interpret the blind control as a realistic election simulation
never inject a second copy of historical candidate or programme values
never identify historical parties, candidates, territories or years
never open 2016 or 2021 outcomes before their registered gate
never generate named 2026 packets from incomplete or single-source candidate data
never invent a candidate, party programme, local reputation or ballot presence
never scale automatically from 32 to 1024 or 94208 decisions
never call a historical pilot paired unless the raw P0 work item is hash-bound
never give every territory the global party panel; use the certified local ballot
never expose source IDs, URLs or hashes to the voter model

information_diet.common_context_boundary: national_context exposes only common_verified_facts; party/candidate material is row-scoped

levels.HIGH: all ballot identities, 18 programme axes, full verified candidate profile
levels.LOW: all ballot identities, up to 5 salient programme axes, salient verified candidate information
levels.MEDIUM: all ballot identities, up to 10 programme axes, basic verified candidate profile

information_diet.purpose: model what each elector plausibly recognizes rather than give every elector the whole database

blind_vs_historical_semiblind.interpretation: framing/attention sensitivity under unchanged historical facts

named_2026_vs_pseudonymized_twin.interpretation: identity-label sensitivity inside the current 2026 information set

BLIND_ATTRIBUTE_CONTROL.current_evidence: one work item / 32 agents already generated

HISTORICAL_SEMIBLIND_RICH.candidate_programme_information: same existing 16 candidate/local features and 18 programme axes
HISTORICAL_SEMIBLIND_RICH.identity_visibility: anonymous party, candidate, election and territory ids
HISTORICAL_SEMIBLIND_RICH.new_semantic_field_rule: requires Bridge V2 before any affected output
HISTORICAL_SEMIBLIND_RICH.prompt_delta: pointer-only card map, candidate pseudonyms, explicit reading instruction and awareness rule
HISTORICAL_SEMIBLIND_RICH.scientific_role: historical development/holdout backtest with rich electoral interpretation and preserved blindness

REALISTIC_2026_NAMED.ballot_surface: territory-specific ballot_party_ids; never one artificial national panel
REALISTIC_2026_NAMED.candidate_verification: VERIFIED_DOUBLE_ENTRY with at least two registered independence clusters
REALISTIC_2026_NAMED.factual_claim_boundary: verified packet sources available by snapshot_known_as_of
REALISTIC_2026_NAMED.identity_visibility: real party, symbol, leader, territory and verified candidate labels
